mission.name: Earth Watch
mission.summary: A 3U CubeSat photographs one region of Earth once a week for 52 weeks. An image counts only when it has been sent to the scientists during a ground pass.

objective.name: Earth Watch
objective.summary: Photograph one region of Earth once a week for 52 weeks, so scientists can see how it changes.

minScience.source: Game balance: minimum science points; below this the camera and link cannot serve the mission

budgetUsd.source: Game balance: total budget proposed by the team for Earth Watch; NASA publishes no budget for a CubeSat of this kind

deadlineMonths.source: CubeSat 101 (NASA CSLI, 2017) chapter 2 p.9: 9 months at the fastest, 18 to 24 typical; the team fixed 24

missionMonths.source: Game balance: 52 weeks of observation, as the team defined Earth Watch

regions.name: Costa Rica forests
regions.summary: Watch the forests of Costa Rica lose or regrow their canopy through a year.

regions.name: The Amazon
regions.summary: Watch a stretch of the Amazon basin change between the wet and the dry season.

regions.name: Arctic sea ice
regions.summary: Watch the Arctic sea ice shrink and grow again through the seasons.

revisits.name: Every week
revisits.summary: One image of the region every week: 52 images in the year.

captureEveryWeeks.source: Game balance: the mission asks for one image per week

revisits.name: Every two weeks
revisits.summary: One image every second week: half the work for the satellite, half the images.

captureEveryWeeks.source: Game balance: a lighter schedule the player may try

attitudes.name: Magnetorquers only
attitudes.summary: Cheap coils that push against Earth's magnetic field. Coarse pointing, and they drift more often.

costUsd.source: Game balance: cheapest pointing option

basePointingDeg.source: Game balance: coarse pointing, just inside a 1 degree tolerance

driftDegPerWeek.source: Game balance: drift after a fault

recalibrateWeeks.source: Game balance: one week without images while it recalibrates

faultChancePerYear.source: Game balance: chance per year of a pointing fault for this hardware

chanceFactor.source: Game balance: both stations rarely fail together

weeks.source: Game balance: Earth Watch lasts one year, as the team defined it

cameraBaseTempC.source: Game balance: camera bay temperature with the camera off

tempPerCameraW.source: Game balance: degrees the camera bay warms per watt the camera draws

stormWeeks.source: Game balance: weeks the storm lasts when nobody answers

pauseRecoverWh.source: Game balance: energy the battery regains when the camera is paused

silenceWeeksLost.source: Game balance: weeks without contact before the satellite is declared lost
